author: Porkyyy
body:
So yeahhhh it's been like 4 months or something.. I needed to take a break and honestly I miss making youtube videos here.

I haven't been on in a while so I'm not sure if there are any new gamemodes or if anything has changed, but I'll see what's new and I'll probably start making videos again :)

I actually just uploaded a video (for the first time in about a month) and it was a rocket league montage with some of my best clips, so that was just to start up my channel again.
If you're interested in rocket league, feel free to check it out -> https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F42ffSBDrqQ

Anyways, it's good to be back :D
